quality_boundary: This Phase 14 inventory verifies Oita's 2025-2034 comprehensive plan, first-year 114-indicator progress route, FY2026/FY2025 budget-lineage context, and pre-plan FY2024 settlement. Municipal progress measures and budget packaging are preserved as source evidence and not converted into independent achievement, causal, or comparison judgments.
